# Finnish humanizer — strip AI markers from Finnish text

Curated by Skill Harbor — a writing-editing skill from the awesome-copilot collection (adapted from Hakku's original finnish-humanizer, MIT) that turns a writing agent into a Finnish copy editor: it identifies and removes 26 AI-text markers (12 Finnish-specific like passive overuse, missing particles, translation structures, genitive chains; 14 universal like significance inflation, sycophantic tone, filler) while preserving factual content, register, code examples, and technical terms, and adding personality through rhythm variation, acknowledged complexity, and concrete detail. Short texts are processed directly; long texts get an analysis-first adaptive workflow with user questions on ambiguous cases. Honest caveats: the guidance itself is written in Finnish, so the operating agent should handle Finnish comfortably; it refuses to make unnecessary changes to already-natural text; the full 26-pattern list lives in an accompanying references file in the source repo. Credit to its creators. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
